## 🎯 Key Highlights

### What Makes FxDC Unique

✅ **Custom Lexer & Parser** — Hand-built tokenization system for FxDC syntax  
✅ **Type-Safe Serialization** — FxDCField descriptors with runtime validation  
✅ **Automatic Class Mapping** — Zero-boilerplate serialization for custom classes  
✅ **Configuration Portability** — Export/import class metadata across projects  
✅ **Custom Serialization Hooks** — `__todata__`/`__fromdata__` for fine-grained control  
✅ **Human-Readable Format** — Pythonic indentation-based syntax  

### Real Code Examples Included

All code snippets are pulled directly from the actual codebase:
- Lexer implementation from `fxdc/parsedata/lexer.py`
- Parser logic from `fxdc/parsedata/parsedata.py`
- Field descriptors from `fxdc/fields.py`
- Config system from `fxdc/config.py`
- Serialization from `fxdc/write.py` and `fxdc/read.py`
- Exception hierarchy from `fxdc/exceptions.py`
- Test examples from `tests/test_fields.py` and `tests/test_fxdc_core.py`
